overview: Badhai Ho – Wedding & Event Films is a luxury cinematic wedding photography and films portfolio website. It showcases wedding films, photography galleries, services, packages, and enables easy client inquiries — all wrapped in a premium matte black and gold aesthetic inspired by cinematic storytelling.
features: Cinematic fullscreen video hero with CTA buttons
Featured wedding films showcase with YouTube/Vimeo player popups
Masonry photo gallery with lightbox previews
Pricing packages with 3 tiers (Silver, Gold, Platinum)
About section with brand story and credentials
Contact form with WhatsApp floating button and social links
Admin panel for managing films, gallery, testimonials, and inquiries
Mobile-first responsive design with smooth cinematic animations
